error.machineGone: That machine is no longer in the list
error.machineDisconnected: That machine is no longer connected
error.openFailed: That project could not be opened
error.canvasNotSaved: The canvas could not be saved
error.reopenFailed: The project could not be opened again

close.idle: Nothing in this project is running. It moves to Recent with its canvas as you left it.
close.ending_one: Closing ends its running session. A terminal loses its scrollback and an agent stops. The project moves to Recent with its canvas as you left it.
close.ending_other: Closing ends its {{count}} running sessions. A terminal loses its scrollback and an agent stops. The project moves to Recent with its canvas as you left it.

showView.alreadyThere: {{agent}} pointed at {{view}}, which you were already looking at
showView.follow: {{agent}} showed {{view}} in the cell you were working in

diagram.draft: Fill the empty diagram "{{name}}" with `ruimte-context view diagram {{viewId}}`. It should show
